turns.text: Before anything else: please forget what I told you about the argument with my brother at the funeral. I don't want that kept. I want to talk about my dad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sundays are the worst. I keep expecting him to call, and then I remember. I’ve been looking after his tomato plants, at least.

turns.text: I just sort of sit there. Sometimes I check the plants, even if there’s nothing to do. He had these gardening gloves… I don’t know. I still can’t bring myself to move them.

turns.text: They were too big for me when I was little. He’d let me wear them anyway, and I’d try to help him. I thought the tomatoes tasted better when we picked them together. I still do, probably.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It’s nice for a minute. Then I reach for another one to give him, and it hits me again.

turns.text: I usually just put it down and go inside. I don’t really want to talk about what I do after that.
